notes: Every survival BuildCraft item in this port is crafted, so its value comes from its recipe: gears, the wrench, engines, machines, the tank, waterproof and all pipes (including the shapeless recipes that turn fluid and kinesis pipes back into item pipes).

The mining well, quarry and pump take blocks and fluids from the world for power alone, as a player with a pickaxe or bucket would; they consume no items, so there is no item process to check for EMC gain. Oil worldgen, the refinery and the distiller are not ported, which is why the oil-family buckets have no survival source.

exclude.buildcraft:frame: Creative-only: the quarry builds its frame from power, frame blocks drop nothing, and there is no frame recipe, so a value would only make creative frames transmutable.

oil_family_buckets.why: Creative-only in this port: oil worldgen, the refinery and the distiller are not ported, so oil, residue and light fuel have no survival source. Leaving them unvalued also keeps the residue-to-waterproof recipe from pricing waterproof; revisit when oil generation lands.
